title: Benchmarking Gender Bias in Machine Translation Evaluation Metrics across Occupations
abstract: arXiv:2609.21490v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gender bias remains a persistent concern in machine translation (MT), affecting both generated translations and their automatic evaluation. When a source text leaves a person's gender unspecified, translations may realize that person using masculine or feminine forms, and both MT systems and evaluation metrics may exhibit systematic preferences between these alternatives despite the source providing no basis for such a distinction. We study this behavior in the WMT 2026 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Systems Shared Task using an occupation-balanced subset of GAMBIT+. We consider seven English-source language pairs, six from the original dataset, targeting Arabic, Czech, Greek, Icelandic, Russian, and Ukrainian, and extend the original resource with German. translated_title: 跨职业的机器翻译评估指标性别偏见基准测试
translated_abstract: 性别偏见仍然是机器翻译（MT）中一个持续存在的问题，它既影响生成的译文，也影响对译文的自动评估。当源文本未指明某人的性别时，译文可能会以阳性或阴性形式来呈现该人物，而无论是机器翻译系统还是评估指标，都可能在这两种选择之间表现出系统性偏好，尽管源文本并没有提供任何做出这种区分的依据。我们在WMT 2026自动翻译质量评估系统共享任务中，使用GAMBIT+的一个职业均衡子集来研究这种行为。我们考虑了七个以英语为源语言的语言对，其中六个来自原始数据集，目标语言为阿拉伯语、捷克语、希腊语、冰岛语、俄语和乌克兰语，并用德语扩展了原始资源。该子集包含每种目标语言1,308对阳性/阴性翻译对，涵盖436个ISCO-08职业类别，每个类别三个示例。我们评估了共享任务（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了一个覆盖七个英语源语言对、436个ISCO-08职业类别的性别均衡基准数据集，用于系统评估WMT 2026共享任务中机器翻译评估指标在性别选择上的偏见。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an occupation-balanced benchmark covering seven English-source language pairs and 436 ISCO-08 occupational groups to systematically evaluate gender bias in machine translation evaluation metrics within the WMT 2026 shared task.
